summary: Executed full Phase 1 frontend E2E testing of Cherry Vibes (React+TS SPA, no backend). Covered Home (hero, 4 category doors, example badges, footer, html lang=pt-BR, single h1), desktop navigation to all 4 categories, catalog filters on /roupas (gender, size XG, color Grafite, price-ordering via sort-select, filter-clear, URL query params for genero/tamanho/cor/ordem), category-specific filters on /maquiagem (filter-shade-* visible; filter-gender/filter-size absent), header search (search-toggle-button + search-form + search-input, navigation to /busca?q=batom with results, product-grid-empty for no-results), product pages for 3 categories (variant-selector, option-tamanho-*, option-cor-*, add-to-cart-error when nothing selected, stock-status after valid selection, cart-count increment, option-tom-* + shade-disclaimer + Peso/volume for maquiagem, option-volume-* + Ingredientes/Modo de uso/Validade for cosmeticos), favorites (toggle aria-pressed, favorites-count, /favoritos list, persistence across reload, favorites-empty-state after removal), cart (cart-drawer, cart-subtotal, cart-increase/decrease, cart-view-link -> /carrinho, cart-page-lines, cart-page-subtotal, persistence after reload), checkout (checkout-form, checkout-validate-button triggers checkout-error-nome and checkout-error-frete, filling fields + shipping-sh-01 updates summary-shipping and summary-total, checkout-pay-button remains disabled by design, payment-pending-notice visible), institutional pages (/sobre, /trocas-e-devolucoes, /privacidade with provisional-notice, /contato with contact-form -> contact-pending-notice on submit), 404 (/rota-inexistente -> /404 with not-found-page and not-found-home-link), admin area (/admin phase banner & overview cards, /admin/produtos table + search + new-product link, admin-form-category switches showing admin-form-section-maquiagem/admin-form-shades and admin-form-ingredients for cosmeticos, admin-form-save shows admin-form-not-saved toast/notice, /admin/estoque table + low-filter, /admin/pedidos table, /admin/frete list), mobile (390x844) menu-open-button -> mobile-menu -> mobile-nav-maquiagem navigation, filters-open-button opens filters-sheet, filters-apply-button closes it.
action_items: Compile issue was fixed by testing agent: added @types/jest and added "types": ["jest", "node"] in /app/frontend/tsconfig.json. Without this, src/lib/filters.test.ts and src/components/product/VariantSelector.test.ts caused TS2582/TS2304 errors (Cannot find name 'describe'/'it'/'expect') and the webpack dev-server showed a 'Compiled with problems:' overlay in the preview URL, which blocks UI usage. Recommend keeping these changes (added to package.json devDeps and tsconfig).
critical_code_review_comments: TypeScript test files (filters.test.ts, VariantSelector.test.ts) are compiled by CRA because they sit under src/ but Jest types were not declared. This caused a blocking compile error in dev. Either (a) move tests outside src/ or (b) include @types/jest in devDependencies with tsconfig types entry (applied by testing agent).
No other critical findings. Code is well structured with pervasive data-testid coverage on all interactive elements, which greatly aids testability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (89/89 assertions after fixing compile error; the 2 false negatives on initial run were due to test script using wrong testid 'contact-mensagem' instead of 'contact-message' and skipping required admin-form-name/price fields — both verified working with correct inputs)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 is purely frontend; REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL points to the preview. Jest types are now wired via tsconfig.json. All data-testid in the spec are present and functional. Toasts come from sonner (short display). HTML5 'required' validation blocks forms until all required fields are filled — remember to fill contact-nome/email/message and admin-form-name/price before clicking submit. Smooth scrolling via Lenis is active. Mobile viewport 390x844 for mobile-menu/filters-sheet tests.
